Name: Mystery Inc. Scarecows for AT - Refreshed
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
Jinkies! Are you exhausted from having your crops randomly disappear? Mystery Inc is on the case!

Included is a scarecrow/ rarecrow/ deluxe scarecrow retextures for Shaggy, Velma, Daphne, Fred and most importantly Scooby Doo!

This is part one of the Mystery Inc Scarecrow series in the proceeding updates I will add Villains - Any requests for specific villains please comment them and I will see what I can do :)

Compatibility Issues - None known

If you do have any issues please post your SMAPI Log in the comments.
